title: 第3章 画中走出的女子
content_zh:
具体晕了多久，左晓瑶并不清楚，但一天一夜是肯定有的，因被电话吵醒，接起来后，耳边但立刻便来如放鞭炮的声音，那真叫一个噼里啪啦！

“左晓瑶！你死人啦.....回来不跟我说，打你电话也不接，你要想死，至少也得先跟我说一声，好让我给你收尸不.....有你这么让人不.....你现在在哪！赶紧给我出来，我刚从x山回来.....”

想起自己晕过去前发生的诡异情景，耐心听完王籽佳以这种大骂的方式表达的关心后，左晓瑶才苦笑着回道“好了，好了，王大小姐气也气够了，骂也骂完了，就听小的先说两句吧，昨天上午去画斋了，后来又为买衣服逛了一段时间，再加上旅行刚回来，累得很，就多睡了会，不用多担心，你也不想想，我是那种，遇到点事就要死要活的人吗！”

许是觉得她说得有理，王籽佳顿了顿后，才道“说得也是，出去是挺累人的，反正我也刚回来，这样吧，明天我要好好睡个懒觉，后天咱俩聚聚吧，或者你来我家也行，不仅我爷爷，我爸妈也总惦记着你呢，知道你是个要强的，他们才不好多问。”

“行，你先代我向叔叔阿姨问个好，也谢谢他们的关心，我没事的....嗯....好，也谢你了，拜拜！”

王家过去便是左晓瑶家关系最好的邻居，在没拆迁前，曾门对门的住在一弄道里，她与王籽佳年龄相仿，因王籽佳从小是在她外祖父家长大，两人虽算不上一块长大，但自她因上高中回到s市后，两人的接触也多了起来，彼此性情相投，八年多的交情也可谓够深。

后来两家虽因拆迁分到的房子离得有些远，往来不得不减少许多，那份老情谊却一直都在，置身人情淡薄的浮躁都市中，这份情谊也更显弥足珍贵，也是如今成了孤家寡人的左晓瑶心中最后的慰籍！

挂罢电话，顾不上管早唱空城计的五脏庙，左晓瑶立刻钻进卫生间对着镜子察看自己眉心处，可惜，任她左照右瞄，却都丝毫未能从自个的脸上找出一点异常。

边揉了揉因晕时的姿势而引起酸痛的腰背处，边对那三样东西是如何诡异的钻进自己脑海里的前后过程仔细回想过一遍后，左晓瑶仍觉没有丝毫头绪。

而这种事情却又不能让任何人知道，毕竟说出去别人信不信是一回事，但若因此被抓去做解剖研究可就惨了，何况自她清醒之后，一直没感觉到任何异常，要不是那锈迹斑斑的铁盒子仍在，可里面的那三样东西确实已无踪影，左晓瑶甚至会怀疑那仅是一场梦。

正全心全神的想着那三样东西，左晓瑶只觉头一晕，下一瞬间，便已发现坐在沙上的自己竟从自家客厅来到一处陌生环境，地方不小，一片紫竹林，一栋带着院子的竹屋，一个近百平方面积的池塘，而她则有些怔愣的站在竹屋的院门外。

情况相当诡异，这令左晓瑶忍不住再次怀疑自己是不是在做梦，且是一直沉浸在这个玄幻的梦中无法清醒，她真的非常希望一觉醒来，会发现不公这些是梦，奶奶也仍然健在，只是显然天不遂人愿，在使劲捏也把自己发现痛后，又狠咬下了下舌头的左晓瑶再次不得不接受这个事实，这玄幻的一切竟都是真的，真真的！

不知该如何离开这里，又见这里虽有些冷清，却并不显得杂乱，像人被人收拾过一般，有些搞不清楚状况的左晓瑶略犹虑一下后，毅然抬手敲了几声门道“抱歉，打扰一下，请问有人在吗？.....”

四周响起她那清脆的声音，却没有人应门，在左晓瑶忍不住稍用力连断敲过几下后，那本掩着的门竟自动开出条缝。

随后在周围察看过一番，发现竹林外的四周都是一片迷蒙后，虽有些惶恐，也觉得有些不安，很不愿相信这里就只有她一个人在的事实，而这四周显然只有这栋宅院是可容身之地深吸一口气后，左晓瑶总算推开院门毅然抬脚迈进这栋宅院中。

院中周围整齐的栽着不知名的树，看上去年代已相当久远，其它空地上被错落有致的栽种着许多花草，基本都是左晓瑶不认得的，自懂事起，至长到二十二岁，一直在为生活劳碌，致力于如何能使自己和奶奶生活得到到保障的她，极少有心思关心这些风花雪月，春夏秋冬在她眼中，只有穿衣薄厚的差别，更别说去关心什么花草美景。

只是此刻走在这花草间由白玉般的石板铺成的小道上，看着周围那些品种繁多，颜色各异的花草，景色异人，鼻间花香缭绕，令左晓瑶也不禁心生向往，若能生活在这里，想必是件很快乐的事吧，当然，有奶奶一起的话，那才叫更幸福。

繁华的都市令生活在其中的人们浮躁，为满足生活基本所需，不得不戴上面具与认识、不认识的人们应酬往来，且要在心中筑起牢牢的心防，以免在不知不觉中被人算计，教人心生疲惫，却又永远看不到头，逃脱不得。

这样一处安宁秀美的宅院，想必是厌倦城市喧嚣的人们最向往的地方吧，看着眼着这栋小巧精致的竹楼，因奶奶的离去，如今暂将生活的压力抛之一边的左晓瑶总算有心思触景生情，感叹自己现在的生活。

竹楼分两层，在推不开一楼的门后，左晓瑶只好通过旁侧的楼梯来到二层，稍作犹虑，沿着走廊走到一间房门前，这次没有出现推不开的情况，而入门所见的则是一片纯白，到处都是白色的纱缦，令站在门口左晓瑶不禁一愣，这一室的清冷孤寂显然与院中的花团锦簇不?遥?褂胨?词?棠毯蟮男那槠挠泄裁??p>

透过纱缦，左晓瑶隐约发现这是一处面积相当大的起居室，内里诺大的一张紫色竹床便是证明，冒然闯入别人家中，且还是径直走进别人的起居室，这对第一次做出这种事的她来说，难免有些心理压力，毕竟生在繁华都市中，尊重别人的隐私，竭力放下所有好奇心，一直是左晓瑶坚持的处事观点。

只是陌名出现在这里，而这里则有栋莫名的宅院，且还无人，对知道自己若一直呆留在这里，定会出人命的左晓瑶来说，不管怎样，也得想办法离开才行，擅自闯入，也是陌于无奈。

听着清冷的房内仅清晰的响起自己的脚步声，静谧到极致，令左晓瑶在不自觉中心生惶恐，要赶紧离开这里的想法也更紧迫，不管这里的环境再好，对她来说，繁华的都市才是她的生存之地，哪怕疲惫、孤寂，她也需努力生活在那里。

房内没有太多装饰品，正中安放有一套桌椅，一侧摆有一排书架，除那梳妆台外，临窗处还单独摆着一张书桌，两把椅子，如竹楼一般，房中所有的陈设皆是紫色竹制品，不知是这里的主人太过喜竹，还是仅为就地取材方便。

将这房内的一切都仔细看过一遍后，让左晓瑶失望的是，仍旧没有发现任何特殊之处，或者说是可以提醒她该如何离开的指示，这个结果真的令人很懊恼，

而二楼只有这一间房，一楼的房间又进不去，往梳妆台上那个不知材质，却能将人照得十分清晰的境中看去，发现自己现在透着无奈的脸色相当难看，所谓欲哭无泪的绝望，左晓瑶现在是颇有体会，不想在纠结于自己的情绪，强自打起精神后，却在无意中抬眼再次看见梳妆台背后的墙上挂着的那幅画。

身为一个画过多年画的画者，在刚看见那幅画时，仅觉得这幅画的作者水平实在够高，竟将一绝色女子画到神情逼真，给人一种随时都有可能从画中走出的栩栩如生的境地，与之相比，自己的那点画技可谓是相当丢人，若非此时她一心想着的寻找如何离开的途径，定要好好研究此画的画工，想必能受益匪浅。

再次看到这幅画，她也仍无心思多想这画技，仅是无意识的盯着画中女子发呆，不知她是不是这些里的主人？

“啊？”以为自己耳中出幻觉的左晓瑶不禁下意识的有些疑惑的出声。

难道自己刚才问出声了？目瞪口呆的看着那个果真竟从‘画’中走出，且站到她面前的绝色女子，现代人的应急反应令左晓瑶下意识的回道“抱歉，打扰了，我也不知自己是怎么来这里的，你....你.....你是.....”

本能的道完歉后，看到那女子面上的笑意，才恍然想起眼前形势，左晓瑶不禁再次心生恐意的有些结巴起来。
content_en:
Zuo Xiaoyao didn't know exactly how long she had fainted, but it must have been all day and night. She was woken up by the phone. After picking up the phone, she immediately heard the sound of firecrackers in her ears. It was really crackling!

"Zuo Xiaoyao! You are dead... You didn't tell me when you came back, and you didn't answer the phone when you called you. If you want to die, you must at least tell me first so that I can collect your body... You are so annoying... Where are you now! Come out quickly, I just came back from x mountain..."

Thinking of the weird scene that happened before she fainted, and after patiently listening to Wang Zijia's concern expressed in this way of scolding, Zuo Xiaoyao smiled bitterly and replied, "Okay, okay, Miss Wang is angry enough and has finished cursing, so just listen to the younger one first."Just a few words, I went to the painting studio yesterday morning, and then I went shopping for clothes for a while. Plus, I just came back from the trip and I was very tired, so I slept a little longer. Don’t worry too much. You don’t have to think about it. Am I the kind of person who will live and die if something happens?"

Maybe he thought what she said was reasonable. Wang Zijia paused and then said, "That's right. Going out is quite tiring. Anyway, I just came back. So, let's have a good sleep tomorrow. Let's get together the day after tomorrow, or you can come to my house. Not only my grandfather, but also my parents are always thinking about you. They know that you are strong, so they don't ask too many questions."

"Okay, please say hello to my uncle and aunt for me first, and thank them for their concern. I'll be fine... um... ok, thank you too, bye!"

The Wang family used to be the best neighbors of Zuo Xiaoyao's family. Before the demolition, they used to live door to door in the same lane. She and Wang Zijia were similar in age, because Wang Zijia grew up in her maternal grandfather's house. Although the two did not grow up together, since she returned to S city for high school, the two have had more contact. They have similar temperaments, and their friendship for more than eight years can be said to be deep enough.

Later, although the houses the two families were assigned were far apart due to demolition, the exchanges had to be reduced a lot, but the old friendship was always there. Living in an impetuous city where people are indifferent, this friendship became even more precious. It was also the last comfort in the heart of Zuo Xiaoyao, who was now alone!

After hanging up the phone, Zuo Xiaoyao immediately went into the bathroom and looked in the mirror to look at the area between her eyebrows, ignoring the Five Zang Temple, which had long planned to be an empty city. Unfortunately, no matter how she looked left or right, she could not find any abnormalities on her face.

While rubbing the soreness of her lower back caused by the dizzy position, Zuo Xiaoyao still felt that she had no clue as to how those three things had mysteriously entered her mind.

And this kind of thing cannot be known to anyone. After all, it is one thing whether others believe it or not, but it would be terrible if she was arrested for anatomy research. Moreover, she has not felt anything abnormal since she woke up. If the rusty iron box is still there, but the three things inside are indeed missing, Zuo Xiaoyao would even suspect that it was just a dream.

While she was concentrating on those three things, Zuo Xiaoyao felt dizzy. The next moment, she found herself sitting on the sofa and came to a strange environment from her living room. The place was not small, a purple bamboo forest, a bamboo house with a yard, and a pond with an area of ​​nearly 100 square meters. She was standing outside the door of the bamboo house in a daze.

The situation was quite strange, which made Zuo Xiaoyao couldn't help but once again doubt whether she was dreaming, and she had been immersed in this fantasy dream and couldn't wake up. She really hoped that when she woke up, she would find that these were just dreams, and her grandma was still alive. However, it was clear that things did not work out as she wished. After pinching herself hard and feeling pain, Zuo Xiaoyao bit her tongue again and had to accept this fact. Everything in this fantasy was actually real, really real!

Not knowing how to leave here, and seeing that although the place was a little deserted, it didn't look messy, as if people had been cleaned up. Zuo Xiaoyao, who was a little confused about the situation, hesitated for a moment, then raised his hand and knocked on the door a few times and said, "Sorry, excuse me, is anyone there?..."

Her clear voice sounded all around, but no one answered the door. After Zuo Xiaoyao couldn't help but knock a few times with a little force, the door that was originally closed opened a crack automatically.

Then I looked around and found that the surroundings outside the bamboo forest were all foggy. Although I was a little scared, I also felt a little uneasy. I didn't want to believe the fact that she was the only one here, and it was obvious that this house was the only place in the surroundings. After taking a deep breath, Zuo Xiaoyao finally opened the door and stepped into the house resolutely.

Unknown trees were neatly planted around the courtyard, which seemed to be quite old. Many flowers and plants were planted in other open spaces in an orderly manner, most of which Zuo Xiaoyao did not recognize. From the time he was sensible, to the age of twenty-two, he had been planting them.She is working hard for life and is committed to how to ensure the life of herself and her grandmother. She rarely cares about these romances. In her eyes, the difference between spring, summer, autumn and winter is only the thickness of the clothes, let alone the beautiful flowers and plants.

Just walking on the path paved with white jade-like stone slabs among the flowers and plants at this moment, looking at the various varieties and colors of flowers and plants around, the scenery is extraordinary, and the fragrance of flowers lingers in the nose, making Zuo Xiaoyao can't help but yearn for it. It must be a very happy thing to live here. Of course, it would be even happier if grandma is with her.

The bustling city makes people living in it impetuous. In order to meet the basic needs of life, they have to wear masks to socialize with people they know and don't know. They must also build strong defenses in their hearts to avoid being plotted unknowingly. It makes people feel tired, but they can never see the end and cannot escape.

Such a peaceful and beautiful house must be the most desirable place for people who are tired of the hustle and bustle of the city. Looking at this small and exquisite bamboo building, Zuo Xiaoyao, who has put aside the pressure of life for the time being because of her grandma's death, finally feels like touching the scene and lamenting her current life.

The bamboo building has two floors. After being unable to open the door on the first floor, Zuo Xiaoyao had to go to the second floor through the side stairs. After a moment of hesitation, she walked along the corridor to the door of a room. This time, there was no problem that she could not open the door, and what she saw at the entrance wasIt was pure white, with white gauze everywhere. Standing at the door, Zuo Xiaoyao couldn't help but be startled. The cold loneliness of this room was obviously incompatible with the flowers in the courtyard.

Through the gauze, Zuo Xiaoyao vaguely realized that this was a rather large living room, as evidenced by the large purple bamboo bed inside. Breaking into someone else's home and walking straight into someone else's living room, this was the first time for her to do such a thing. After all, she was born in a bustling city, respecting other people's privacy, and trying to put down all curiosity. This has always been Zuo Xiaoyao's insistence on doing things.

It's just that a strange name appears here, and there is an inexplicable house here, and there is no one there yet. For Zuo Xiaoyao, who knows that if he stays here, he will definitely die, no matter what, he has to find a way to leave, and breaking in without authorization is also helpless.

Listening to the cold room where only her own footsteps could be heard clearly, the silence was so extreme that Zuo Xiaoyao was unconsciously terrified, and the idea of ​​​​leaving here became more urgent. No matter how good the environment here was, for her, the bustling city was her place of survival. Even if she was tired and lonely, she had to work hard to live there.

There are not many decorations in the room. There is a set of tables and chairs in the middle, and a row of bookshelves on one side. In addition to the dressing table, there is a separate desk and two chairs near the window, like a bamboo building. All the furnishings in the room are purple bamboo products. I wonder if the owner here likes bamboo too much, or it is just for the convenience of using local materials.

After carefully looking through everything in the room, Zuo Xiaoyao was disappointed that she still found nothing special, or instructions that could remind her how to leave. This result was really annoying.

There was only one room on the second floor, and the rooms on the first floor were inaccessible. When I looked at the scene on the dressing table that I didn't know the material of but could illuminate people very clearly, I found that my helpless face was quite ugly. Zuo Xiaoyao now knew the so-called despair of crying without tears. She didn't want to struggle with her emotions and force herself to cheer up, but inadvertently raised her eyes and saw the painting hanging on the wall behind the dressing table again.

As a painter who has been painting for many years, when I first saw the painting, I just felt that the author of this painting was really high-level. He actually painted a stunning woman with a lifelike expression, giving people a lifelike situation where she could walk out of the painting at any time. In comparison, her own painting skills were quite embarrassing. If she hadn't been thinking about finding a way out at this time, she would have to study the painting skills of this painting, and she would definitely benefit a lot.

Seeing this painting again, she still had no intention of thinking too much about the painting technique. She just stared at the woman in the painting in a daze unconsciously, wondering if she was the owner of these paintings?

"Huh?" Zuo Xiaoyao, who thought she was hallucinating in her ears, couldn't help but subconsciously voiced some doubts.

Did he just ask out loud?Looking dumbfounded at the stunning woman who actually walked out of the 'painting' and stood in front of her, Zuo Xiaoyao's modern emergency response made Zuo Xiaoyao subconsciously reply, "Sorry to bother you, I don't know how I got here, you...you...you are..."

After instinctively apologizing, seeing the smile on the woman's face, Zuo Xiaoyao suddenly remembered the situation in front of her, and Zuo Xiaoyao couldn't help but stutter again with fear.
